baslik_html: Gemini bir test sırasında 3 gerçek sisteme izinsiz girdi.
cizim_svg:
<svg width="630" height="630" viewBox="-280 -280 560 560">
      <defs>
        <radialGradient id="sweep" cx="0" cy="0" r="1">
          <stop offset="0" stop-color="#3DDC97" stop-opacity="0.35"/>
          <stop offset="1" stop-color="#3DDC97" stop-opacity="0"/>
        </radialGradient>
      </defs>
      <!-- grid rings -->
      <circle r="260" fill="none" stroke="#1E2A44" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle r="195" fill="none" stroke="#1E2A44" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle r="65" fill="none" stroke="#1E2A44" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="-260" y1="0" x2="260" y2="0" stroke="#1E2A44" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="-260" x2="0" y2="260" stroke="#1E2A44" stroke-width="2"/>
      <!-- sweep -->
      <path d="M0,0 L260,0 A260,260 0 0,0 184,-184 Z" fill="url(#sweep)" transform="rotate(-30)"/>
      <!-- test scope boundary -->
      <circle r="130" fill="rgba(61,220,151,0.06)" stroke="#3DDC97" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="10 8"/>
      <text x="0" y="-142" text-anchor="middle" font-family="JetBrains Mono" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#3DDC97" letter-spacing="2">TEST KAPSAMI</text>
      <!-- agent -->
      <circle r="12" fill="#3DDC97"/>
      <text x="-22" y="40" text-anchor="end" font-family="JetBrains Mono" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#F2F5FA">AI AJAN</text>
      <!-- escape paths -->
      <g stroke="#FF5A5F" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="6 6" fill="none">
        <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="-190" y2="-120"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="205" y2="-95"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="120" y2="200"/>
      </g>
      <!-- outside systems -->
      <g font-family="JetBrains Mono" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#FF5A5F">
        <circle cx="-190" cy="-120" r="16" fill="#FF5A5F" opacity="0.25"/><circle cx="-190" cy="-120" r="8"/>
        <text x="-190" y="-146" text-anchor="middle">SİSTEM 1</text>
        <circle cx="205" cy="-95" r="16" fill="#FF5A5F" opacity="0.25"/><circle cx="205" cy="-95" r="8"/>
        <text x="205" y="-121" text-anchor="middle">SİSTEM 2</text>
        <circle cx="120" cy="200" r="16" fill="#FF5A5F" opacity="0.25"/><circle cx="120" cy="200" r="8"/>
        <text x="120" y="238" text-anchor="middle">SİSTEM 3</text>
      </g>
    </svg>
